sequence.title: The First Impact
sequence.objective: Demonstrate Thragg's terrifying physical power and introduce Infinity as deceleration, not a wall; Thragg stops attacking and starts investigating.
sequence.logic: Thragg's opening move is to end the fight with one blow (S2-01). It slows without end 1 cm from Gojo's blindfold, and grit thrown at bullet speed hangs in the gap. This is the plant Seq 7 pays off. From then on every attack is an experiment that rules out one hypothesis. Target and trajectory: a hook to the temple, a knee to the ribs, a low kick to the knee (S2-04 to S2-06). Footing: the sweep shears the mast arm, and Gojo keeps standing on nothing (S2-06, S2-07). Reflex: a feint gets no reaction, and the real strike comes from the blind flank, then from directly above (S2-08, S2-09). Thragg's eyes go from confusion to analysis: he isn't defending, something is (S2-10). Mass: a four-tonne slab stalls and then simply drops (S2-11). Speed and attention: a 300 m loop through the storm deck, then a maximum-speed dive from high behind Gojo's right (S2-12, S2-13). Gojo turns calmly to face him before he arrives. The stall is identical, and the boom wrecks the street around him but not his collar (S2-14). Thragg's conclusion is that this is a property of the space around the man, so conventional force is not enough. He withdraws to 30 m and studies Gojo with growing hostility (S2-15), which hands off to Seq 3's Blue. Gojo never defends, never moves a hand to block, and never evades: Infinity is automatic (G1-09, X1-03). His only actions are acting beats: a head tilt, a weight shift, a pinch gesture and the turn. Screen direction stays Gojo-left/Thragg-right throughout. The one reversal (S2-13) is set up by the visible contrail loop in S2-12 and restored by Thragg's backward withdrawal in S2-15.
sequence.music_cue: Seq 1's silence was broken by the launch crack. S2-01 to S2-03 are near-silent: sub rumble plus the hanging infinity_stop ring, with the score ducked under the line. The 96 BPM low percussion and electronic pulse RETURN on Thragg's reset at S2-04 f0 (one beat = 15 frames). Low brass stabs fall BETWEEN blows, never on a stall, and the music thins under every infinity_stop so the ring reads. There is a low brass hit as the mast arm falls (S2-06). Thragg's motif (descending minor third) is a STINGER on the analytical narrowing of his eyes (S2-10). It SWELLS with the climb (S2-12) and DROPS OUT 4 frames before the dive arrives (S2-13), so the boom and the ring play alone through S2-14. It RETURNS low in S2-15, with Thragg's motif over a bare pulse, handing off to Seq 3's 112 BPM.
sequence.state_out: Gojo: standing on air where the mast arm was, west corner, x=-6, y=6; facing east; eyes blindfold; injuries none; hands in pockets. Thragg: hovering 30 m up over the east side of the intersection, x=+12, y=30; facing west; cape full; injuries none; calm turned analytical, now with growing hostility. Env: landing crater at x=0; mast arm sheared and fallen (the pole still stands); torn-up street slab (hole at x=+7..+10, slab broken beneath Gojo); ring of blown-out windows around the west corner; lamp posts flattened (env flags: landing_crater, mast_sheared).

shots.angle: low angle from street level, near-profile
shots.camera: Locked off at street level 22 m south of the intersection, facing north, framing the crater (screen-right) and the west-corner mast (screen-left). A 4-frame whip-tilt up-left follows Thragg's streak, then the camera locks on the pair.
shots.screen_direction: Thragg travels right to left and upward (east to west, crater to mast); Gojo is screen-left facing screen-right.
shots.staging: Thragg leaves the crater at x=0, y=0.5, already airborne (Seq 1 ended on his anticipation frame). He flies a straight diagonal toward Gojo's face at x=-6, y=7.95. f2: Thragg's body at x=-4.2, y=6.0. f10: body at x=-5.0, y=6.3 (boot soles), fist at x=-5.99. Gojo is static on the mast arm, soles at x=-6, y=6.2, facing east. Camera centre moves from x=-3, y=4 to x=-5.5, y=7; zoom 30 to 70.
shots.action: f0-1: Thragg is a white-and-crimson streak tearing up out of the landing crater, cape snapped flat behind him, a vapour cone peeling off his shoulders; asphalt shards from his launch ride the shock just ahead of him. f2: he is at arm's length, right straight extended at Gojo's head; the fist covers 80% of the remaining gap in 2 frames. f4: the deceleration begins. There is no contact flash; the air ahead of the knuckles compresses into a thin, rippling disc. f4-10: the fist gains only 15% more. Thragg's body keeps travelling a moment longer than his fist, so his shoulder bunches and his elbow bends. f6-14: the shock's side lobes flow around Gojo and blow out the windows of the west-corner facades behind him in a staggered ring. f10-22: the fist crawls, then hangs 1 cm from the blindfold. Gojo has not moved at all; his hands are in his pockets.
shots.animatic_caption: Thragg crosses the gap in an instant: a right straight at Gojo's head. It slows, and slows.
shots.prompt_core: Wide low-angle shot from street level of a storm-dark dusk intersection. A massively built man in a white-and-crimson bodysuit and crimson cape blasts diagonally up from a fresh crater toward a tall white-haired man in a black high-collared uniform and blindfold, who stands casually on a traffic-light arm six metres up with his hands in his pockets. A white vapour cone peels off the attacker's shoulders, his cape snapped flat behind him, asphalt shards racing ahead of him. His fully extended right fist decelerates sharply a finger's width from the blindfold. A thin, rippling disc of compressed air sits ahead of the knuckles, shards slow in the air, and his shoulder bunches as his body outruns his stalled arm. Behind the standing man, windows in the facades burst outward in a ring. Warm sunset rim light from screen-left.

tactical.intent: End it with one blow to the head before the stranger can act.
tactical.read: Gojo does not react at all, because Infinity is automatic. Thragg reads no guard and no flinch.
tactical.outcome: The fist slows without end and never arrives. The side lobes of the shock blow out the windows behind Gojo.
tactical.learned: Something is slowing his fist, and there was no impact to feel.

shots.animation_notes: Thragg on 1s throughout. Gojo is a held cel with no secondary motion, not even in his hair. Deceleration curve per the VFX bible: 80% in 2 frames, +15% over 6, then a crawl. The body compresses behind the fist (shoulder up, elbow bent 10-15 degrees), with no bounce and no recoil. The cape keeps travelling and wraps forward over Thragg's shoulders as his body decelerates. Smear frame on f0-1 only.

asphalt shards riding the shock ahead of him
compressed-air disc ahead of the knuckles (refraction ripple, no flash)
fx.zeno on the fist for the remaining distance
fx.glass_shatter on the west-corner facades behind Gojo (side lobes)
speed_lines on f0-2 only

shots.action: f0-20: the fist creeps forward by millimetres. The knuckle ridges tense, the glove leather creaks and the forearm trembles with full Viltrumite drive, yet it gains almost nothing. In the 1 cm gap, and in a loose cloud around the knuckles, grit and asphalt shards that arrived at bullet speed hang, jittering microscopically and never getting closer. The background seen through the gap bends faintly, like heat over glass. f20-34: everything hangs. Gojo's blindfold, white hair and high collar are perfectly still. There is no flash, no ring of light and no surface.
shots.animatic_caption: KEY PLANT: the fist hangs 1 cm short and shards hang in the gap. No wall, just endless slowing.
shots.prompt_core: Extreme close-up in exact profile. On the left, a pale face with a black cloth blindfold and spiky snow-white hair; on the right, a huge crimson-gloved fist frozen a finger's width from the blindfold. In that tiny gap and around the knuckles, grit and sharp asphalt shards hang motionless in the air, each one jittering slightly and none touching skin. The background seen through the gap bends faintly like heat haze over glass. The forearm trembles with strain, glove leather creased over the knuckles. There is no glow, no force field and no impact flash, only stillness and suspended fragments. Warm orange rim light from the left catches the edge of the blindfold, cool blue-violet storm light falls on the glove, and the dark dusk city is blurred behind.

tactical.intent: Push through: drive the fist the last centimetre.
tactical.read: Gojo still does not move. The resistance comes from nowhere Thragg can see.
tactical.outcome: The fist gains millimetres, then nothing, and the shards hang.
tactical.learned: There is no surface to push against.

shots.animation_notes: Fist on 1s, its micro-creep on a decaying curve (each frame advances half as far as the previous one). Shards: 12-20 pieces, each with its own 1-2 px jitter and zero net drift toward Gojo. Refraction only inside the gap, strongest at the fist. Gojo is a held cel. This frame is the template for Seq 7's payoff: lock the composition (profile, fist screen-right, about 1 cm gap) into the model pack.

shots.action: f0-16: Gojo inclines his head a few degrees, looking through the blindfold at the knuckles hanging a centimetre from his face. f18-32: his chin lifts and he turns his face up to Thragg's eyes; the corner of his mouth curls. f28-36: he slides his right hand out of his pocket and raises it beside the fist, thumb and forefinger pinched almost shut, showing a 1 cm gap. f36-80: GOJO: "That's close. For you." (a half-beat pause after 'close'). f44-62: in the soft foreground, Thragg's eyes drop to his own knuckles; there was no impact to feel. f60-68: his stalled fingers flex once inside the glove. f68-88: hold on Gojo's light smile while Thragg's jaw sets.
shots.animatic_caption: Gojo looks at the fist, then at Thragg, and pinches a 1 cm gap: "That's close. For you."
shots.prompt_core: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind a massive man's left shoulder and crimson cape, soft in the right foreground. His right arm reaches across the frame, crimson fist frozen a finger's width from the face of a tall white-haired man in a black blindfold and high-collared black uniform, who stands on a traffic-light arm. Grit and asphalt shards hang motionless around the fist. The blindfolded man tilts his head toward the knuckles, then lifts his face toward the attacker with a faint, amused smile, and raises one hand beside the fist with thumb and forefinger pinched almost shut. Behind him are blown-out windows in dark towers; far beyond, a glowing lit city skyline sits under a smouldering sunset. Warm rim light from screen-left on his white hair.

tactical.intent: Hold the strike and read the man who stopped it.
tactical.read: Gojo is unbothered, even joking. Thragg reads no strain, no technique stance and no defence.
tactical.outcome: Nothing changes: the fist hangs 1 cm away while Gojo talks.
tactical.learned: His knuckles felt nothing. It is not a wall; his fist is SLOWING.

shots.animation_notes: Gojo on 2s for the acting (head tilt, chin lift, pinch). The fist and shards stay locked exactly where S2-02 left them, matching the hang. Thragg in the foreground moves only his eyes and fingers, never his body: stillness is power. Mouth shapes for 4 words plus a 6-frame pause after 'close'. The score ducks 8 dB under the line.

shots.action: f0-4: Thragg snaps the stalled right back to his chin, with no hesitation and no frustration. f4-10: anticipation. His hips coil, his left shoulder drops and his weight rolls onto the rear hip; he is hovering, but the body mechanics are a grounded boxer's. f11: CONTACT FRAME (stall). A whipping left hook arrives at Gojo's right temple and decelerates; a compressed-air ripple bends the light ahead of the glove, with no flash. f11-20: the hook crawls and hangs 1 cm from the temple, and grit swept up by the arc hangs in a short curved line. f14-26: Gojo tilts his head a few degrees TOWARD the stalled fist, as if listening to it, his free right hand loose at his side. f26-34: Thragg's eyes flick to the hanging grit.
shots.animatic_caption: Hook to the temple: the arc stalls a centimetre out. Gojo tilts his head toward it, unbothered.
shots.prompt_core: Medium shot at rooftop height at dusk, three-quarter view from the side. A massive warrior in white and crimson, with close-cropped black hair and a black mustache, hovers in mid-air and throws a whipping left hook with full hip rotation at the temple of a tall blindfolded white-haired man in a black high-collared uniform, who stands on a traffic-light arm. The hook decelerates and hangs a finger's width from the temple. A faint curved ripple of compressed air bends the background ahead of the glove, and a short arc of grit floats motionless along the swing's path. The blindfolded man calmly tilts his head toward the fist, one hand loose at his side. Blown-out windows behind; warm rim light from screen-left, cool storm fill.

tactical.intent: Find a gap by changing target and trajectory: a curved strike to the side of the head.
tactical.read: Gojo makes no move to slip it; he tilts toward it.
tactical.outcome: The hook decelerates and hangs at the same 1 cm as the straight.

shots.animation_notes: Thragg on 1s for the hook: anticipation f4-10, contact f11, and the follow-through is his body compressing behind the stalled glove (elbow folds, shoulder rises). Gojo on 2s, a 4-degree head tilt eased over 12 frames. Never reuse S2-01's stall drawing: different arm angle, fist turned palm-down, curved ripple.

shots.action: f0-5: Thragg releases the hook and, with no reset, rips his hips back and down; the whole frame of him coils above us (anticipation). f6: his right knee drives up and across into Gojo's left floating ribs. f7: STALL. The knee decelerates and hangs 1 cm from the jacket; the thigh compresses into his hip and his trailing cape whips past. Flakes of the mast's paint and grit hang in a loose cluster under the knee. f10-30: Gojo shifts his weight a fraction from his left foot to his right on the narrow steel arm. It is the only movement he makes.
shots.animatic_caption: Knee to the ribs, seen from below the pair: it hangs. Gojo just shifts his weight on the steel arm.
shots.prompt_core: Extreme low-angle shot from the street looking almost straight up at two figures six metres overhead, against a dark storm-cloud ceiling lit orange at the left edge by the hidden sunset. A massive warrior in white and crimson, hovering in mid-air, drives a rising knee into the ribs of a tall blindfolded man in a black high-collared uniform, who stands on a bent traffic-light arm. The knee stops just short of the jacket and hangs; flakes of paint and grit float motionless beneath it. The warrior's crimson cape whips past in the wind. The blindfolded man calmly shifts his weight onto one foot, unconcerned. Traffic-light housings dangle from the arm, and broken windows glint in the towers framing the shot.

tactical.intent: Change elevation and attack the body from below the guard line.
tactical.read: Gojo doesn't guard the body: no elbow drops and he doesn't turn.
tactical.outcome: The knee stalls at the same distance as the head strikes.

Gojo's weight shift on 2s over f10-26: hips settle, one knee softens. Silhouette clarity: keep the knee and Gojo's ribs against open sky, not against the arm.

The heel slams the steel arm 1 m east of Gojo's toes, throwing sparks, and the arm kinks into a V. f27-29: the heel's arc carries on toward Gojo's ankles and stalls 1 cm short. f28-32: the kinked arm tears off its bolted root plate at the pole with a shriek of metal. f32-50: the whole arm drops away beneath Gojo, traffic-light heads swinging, and cartwheels into the street. f50: it smashes onto the asphalt, cracking it. f32-56: Gojo stays exactly where he was, soles level on empty air, weight still on one leg. f34-46: he tilts his head a few degrees to 'watch' the arm fall.
shots.animatic_caption: The low kick stalls, and the spinning sweep shears the mast arm. The arm falls. Gojo doesn't.
shots.prompt_core: Wide profile shot six metres up at dusk. A tall blindfolded white-haired man in a black high-collared uniform stands on a long traffic-light arm reaching across a ruined intersection. A massive white-and-crimson warrior hovering low beside him spins through a flat heel sweep that smashes the steel arm just beside the man's feet, throwing sparks. The arm kinks, rips off its bolted mount on the pole and drops away, traffic lights swinging, tumbling toward the asphalt below. The warrior's heel hangs frozen a finger's width from the man's ankle. The blindfolded man stays exactly in place, standing on empty air, one hand loose, head tilted. A crater and cracked asphalt below, blown-out windows, storm-dark sky, warm light from screen-left.

tactical.intent: Take away his footing: sweep the leg, then the platform.
tactical.read: Gojo doesn't brace or step; he ignores the arm going.
tactical.outcome: The low kick stalls. The sweep shears the arm and the heel stalls at his ankle. The arm falls, and Gojo stays in the air.
tactical.learned: Angle and target don't matter, and he needs no footing.

shots.animation_notes: Kick and sweep on 1s. The plant-and-spin must read as Thragg's body turning first, then the leg path following. The real contact with the arm gets heavy-tier treatment (star plus sparks, 4 frames of shake). It is the only contact flash in the shot, and it is on the steel, not on Gojo. The arm falls under real gravity (6 m is about 26 frames). Gojo is held absolutely still from f26 apart from the head tilt (f34-46, on 2s), with no drop and no wobble.

Far below, through the gap, dust boils up off the fallen arm. f10-30: the camera tilts up his still body, past the loose right hand and the zipped high collar, to his face. f18-30: he settles his weight onto one leg on nothing, as if leaning on a railing; the faint smile from before hasn't moved. f30-36: hold.
shots.animatic_caption: His shoes rest on empty air. He shifts his weight. He doesn't need the arm.
shots.prompt_core: Low-angle close-up of a pair of black leather shoes resting flat on empty air six metres above a ruined street at dusk. Beside them is a torn, twisted steel mounting plate on a traffic-light pole, its bolts sheared. Far below, dust billows up from a fallen steel arm lying across cracked asphalt. The camera tilts up a tall man's black uniform trousers and high-collared jacket to his face: snow-white spiky hair, a black blindfold, a relaxed, faintly amused mouth. He leans his weight onto one leg as if resting against a railing, completely at ease, standing on nothing. Warm orange rim light from the left edges his silhouette, with storm clouds above.

tactical.intent: Gojo: none needed. He lets Thragg see that footing was never the point.
tactical.read: Thragg, off-screen, watches him stand on nothing.

Pulling back from the stall, he flies backward up and over Gojo, rising into frame from lower-left and decelerating into a hover in the right foreground, 30 m above the east side of the intersection. He never turns his back. f26-40: his cape billows forward past him and settles; he hangs there, still and unblinking. f18-40: far below-left, Gojo turns back to face east, tracking him up. f36-48: Gojo slides his right hand back into his pocket: both hands in pockets, standing on nothing at the west corner, with the lit city and the sunset beyond him. f40-84: a slow push-in on Thragg's three-quarter profile. His jaw sets, his nostrils flare once (f52), and the analytical look hardens into cold, growing hostility. Below them is the ruined street: the crater, the fallen mast arm, the broken slab, the flattened lamp posts and a ring of blown-out windows.
shots.animatic_caption: Thragg hovers 30 m up, studying Gojo with growing hostility. Gojo, hands in pockets, stands on air.
shots.prompt_core: High shot over the left shoulder of a massive warrior in a white-and-crimson bodysuit, crimson cape billowing, hovering thirty metres above a ruined intersection at storm-dark dusk. His severe pale face, with close-cropped black hair and a black mustache, is in three-quarter profile: jaw set, cold eyes narrowed in growing hostility, looking down to the left. Far below-left, a tall white-haired man in a black blindfold and high-collared uniform stands calmly on empty air beside a bare traffic-light pole, hands in his pockets. Beneath them lie a crater, a fallen traffic-light arm, a broken slab, flattened lamp posts and blown-out windows. Beyond, across a river, a glowing lit city sits under a smouldering orange sunset. Slow push-in.

tactical.intent: Disengage, reset at range and think.
tactical.read: Gojo turns to face him and puts his hands back in his pockets: no pursuit and no counter.
tactical.outcome: A stand-off: Thragg hovering 30 m up over the east side, Gojo on air at the west corner.
tactical.learned: Conventional force is not enough. The next move must be something other than force.

shots.animation_notes: The backward flight is on 1s, easing out to a dead hover. There is no bobbing: a Viltrumite hover is rock-still, and only the cape and hair move. Gojo's turn and hand-to-pocket are on 2s. The push-in is 12% over 44 frames. The hostility lives in micro-acting only (jaw, nostrils, lids). Hand-off to Seq 3: Gojo's right hand comes back out of his pocket at the start of S3-01 to raise two fingers.
